name: 喵喵

description: 本站保留的 Blazehound 历史资料入口。旧官方确认、属性、外形行为、野外身份及栖息地断言缺乏独立国际服依据，现予撤回。保留名称和内部分类仅供导航，不代表实装、官方译名或可用阵容；身份、形象、机制与数值仍待核实。
descriptionEn: This is the legacy Blazehound navigation entry. Earlier claims of official confirmation, type, appearance, behavior, wild identity and habitat lack independent global support and are withdrawn. Retained names and internal classifications are not proof of implementation, official naming or a playable roster. Identity, artwork, mechanics and values remain unverified.
